title: Species Diversity per Outing
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch
| stats dc(species) as species_count, count as total_catches by trip_id
| sort - species_count
description: Tracks which outings produce diversity rather than only volume.
value: Some trips are valuable because they are rich and varied even if no personal best shows up.
implementation: Group catch logs by trip in `index=personal`; calculate distinct species count and total catches.
visualization: Trip table of total catches and distinct species count.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which fishing trips are the most varied, not just the ones with the highest number of fish.
